entries.descriptionHtml: wis DC 20, one creature Valindra can see within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} 22 (4d10) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

traits.name: Flyby (Wyvern or Hybrid Form Only)
traits.descriptionHtml: The werewyvern doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack action when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: The werewyvern makes three attacks, using Javelin or Rend in any combination. It can replace one of these attacks with one Stinger attack.

actions.name: Javelin (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.descriptionHtml: m,r +7, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. {@h}18 (4d6 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Rend
actions.descriptionHtml: m +7, reach 5 ft. {@h}18 (4d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Stinger (Wyvern or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.descriptionHtml: m +7, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 16 (3d10) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the werewyvern's next turn. If the target is a Humanoid, it is subjected to the following effect. con DC 16. {@actSaveFail} The target is cursed. If the cursed target drops to 0 Hit Points, it instead becomes a Werewyvern under the DM's control and has 20 Hit Points. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is immune to this werewyvern's curse for 24 hours.

macro.targets: and the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the start of the werewyvern's next turn

bonusActions.name: Shape-Shift
bonusActions.descriptionHtml: The werewyvern shape-shifts into a Medium wyvern-humanoid hybrid or a Large wyvern, or it returns to its true humanoid form. Its game statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

actions.descriptionHtml: wis DC 15, each creature that isn't currently affected by this breath in a 30-foot Cone [Area of Effect]. {@actSaveFail} The target's Speed is halved, it can't take Reactions, and it can take either an action or a Bonus Action on its turn, not both. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

1e.name: Command
1e.components: V

1e.name: Fear
1e.components: V, S, M (a white feather)

traits.name: Aura of Dread
traits.descriptionHtml: Creatures in a 10-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] originating from the Zhentilar have their Speeds halved while in the Emanation [Area of Effect]. The Zhentilar can designate creatures to be unaffected by the aura.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: The Zhentilar makes three attacks, using Dooming Blade or Oppressive Ray in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.descriptionHtml: m +5, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Oppressive Ray
actions.descriptionHtml: r +5, range 90 ft. {@h}16 (3d10) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.descriptionHtml: m +4, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage.

actions.name: Pistol

actions.descriptionHtml: str DC 12, one creature within 5 feet that the Zhentilar can see. {@actSaveFail} 4 (1d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

spellcasting.header: Zlan casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 19):

2e.name: Dimension Door
2e.components: V

2e.name: Fly
2e.components: V, S, M (a feather)

2e.name: Scrying
2e.components: V, S, M (a focus worth 1,000+ GP, such as a crystal ball, mirror, or water-filled font)

1e.name: Befuddlement
1e.components: V, S, M (a key ring with no keys)

1e.name: Disintegrate
1e.components: V, S, M (a lodestone and dust)

spellcasting.header: Zlan casts Counterspell in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

atWill.name: Counterspell
atWill.castingTime: 1 reaction (which you take when you see a creature within 60 feet of yourself casting a spell with Verbal, Somatic, or Material components)

traits.name: Chardalyn Sense
traits.descriptionHtml: Zlan senses the emotions of anyone touching a piece of chardalyn within 100 miles of itself.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.descriptionHtml: If Zlan fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.descriptionHtml: Zlan has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Next of the Seven (6/Year)
traits.descriptionHtml: If Zlan dies within 100 miles of a piece of chardalyn at least 4 inches long, it re-forms from that piece of chardalyn in 1d10 days, regaining all its Hit Points. The new body appears in the unoccupied space nearest to the piece of chardalyn, and another lich's mind in the body seizes psychic control of the body.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: Zlan makes three attacks, using Slam or Bewildering Bolt in any combination. It can replace two attacks with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Slam
actions.descriptionHtml: m +11, reach 10 ft. {@h}12 (3d4 + 5) Bludgeoning damage plus 22 (4d10) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Bewildering Bolt
actions.descriptionHtml: r +11, range 120 ft. {@h}27 (4d10 + 5) Psychic damage, and the target has the Charmed condition until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Stoke Paranoia
entries.descriptionHtml: wis DC 19, one creature Zlan can see within 30 feet (with Disadvantage if the target is holding or wearing chardalyn). {@actSaveFail} 27 (6d8) Psychic damage and the target has the Charmed condition for 1 minute or until Zlan dies. While Charmed, the target doesn't act as an ally to any creature. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} Zlan can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.
